calls.reason: DataReportal reports later audience estimates that vary substantially. The packet has no verified January total accounting for overlap between app and web users.
CNBC reports $13.1 billion in 2025 revenue and $8 billion in cash burn. The revenue assumption did not hold, and cash burn cannot establish the spending and loss measures in this conditional claim.

Anthropic's filing reports $386 million in 2024 revenue from usage and subscriptions, and its Enterprise plan launched before the post. These concrete commercial products undermine the categorical productization claim.

The arXiv impossibility result uses a narrower formal definition, while Nature identifies incentives and abstention as routes to improvement. Neither settles whether useful LLMs must make false factual assertions.

Court-reported figures show 90 million monthly Gemini users in October 2024, but also a substantial gap behind rivals. Copilot usage and attributable spending are missing, and categorical failure has no clear threshold.

CNBC's February 20 interview reports 400 million weekly users, up 33% since December, and describes consumer adoption. Though company-reported, that scale and growth clearly cut against complete adoption failure.
